reviews.original_wording: 就业数据压低近期加息预期，十年期收益率仍在 5.28% 左右，短期政策预期缓和没有消除高长端融资成本。
reviews.evidence: 10y closed ~5.31% on 2026-10-05 and hit 5.36% intraday on 2026-10-07 (highest since Apr 2002); FOMC minutes show unanimous support for Sept hike.

reviews.original_wording: Reuters 引述知情人士称，OpenAI 年化经常性收入已接近 700 亿美元
reviews.evidence: FT (via CNN, 2026-10-08): OpenAI told investors annualized revenue nearing $50B; $70B figure did not come from OpenAI and likely reflected a gross-revenue comparable basis.

reviews.original_wording: 降息预期回升，也没有消除长端融资成本的压力。

reviews.original_wording: AI投资仍有强劲需求基础，信用扩张和回款周期则需要更细地检验。
reviews.evidence: Samsung Q3 OP guidance KRW 107.4T and TSMC Sept revenue +54.6% YoY support demand; OpenAI annualized revenue ~$50B (net) vs ~$70B assumed weakens demand-strength inference.
